scope: All77 inventory; source-level analysis of saved failures and previously reviewed evidence losses. Existing judgments remain unchanged.
selection_boundary: Use failure union and existing source-review cases, not every changed citation as a failure. Preserve alternatives, optional-detail distinctions and HOLD.

structure_levels.DIRECT: Required value/relationship is in row/cell axes with correct period, scope, unit and source binding in the existing artifact.
structure_levels.BOUND_CONTEXT: Literal row/cell is available; an existing source-bound table caption/period context is necessary to complete interpretation. Coarse scalar hints may be inaccurate.
structure_levels.CONDITIONAL_BOUND_CONTEXT: Descriptive audit subtype added at synthesis, not a new scoring gate: literal facts and bound context exist, but a pre-existing HOLD about ranking universe or scope remains. No answer grade is assigned.
structure_levels.INCOMPLETE: At least one required axis/subject/unit/period link is missing or misleading and cannot be resolved from the stored table object alone.
structure_levels.NOT_TABLE: The missing requirement is narrative, reasoning, contract compliance or request ambiguity; not solved by table structure alone.
structure_levels.UNRESOLVED: Stored evidence does not justify a conclusive classification; never equated with original source absence.

failure_layers.selection_delivery: A required source exists in the saved candidate pool but is outside selected k or actually omitted from packet.
failure_layers.axis_binding: Period, subject/scope, or unit relation is missing, wrong or not represented at the needed granularity.
failure_layers.candidate_absence: Verified source exists in corpus but is absent from that arm's saved candidates.
failure_layers.source_absence_unproven: No verified supporting source established; not proof the full filing lacks it.
failure_layers.other: Generation, refusal policy, execution contract, narrative requirement or benchmark ambiguity.

causal_limits: Failure layers may overlap; do not sum them as mutually exclusive causes.
Gold/reference values may locate diagnostic witnesses but are never inputs to a proposed runtime retriever.
Source-ID or numeric-string match alone is insufficient.
Scalar period_focus/year/unit_hint/row_label cannot override physical table axes.
Stored metadata availability does not imply it appeared in model input.
Identifiability is source inspection with the target known, not demonstrated query-to-fact mapping.
No fresh accuracy, inference significance, heldout generalization or treatment effect is measured.
output_boundary: Write only in this new audit directory; no source/docs/config/store mutation, no restart, no commit.
